scope: Synthetic shared-module repair; not platform acceptance

children.name: Filtering and pagination agreement
children.description: Repair the supplied CommonJS modules. Preserve exports and integer page contracts. Do not mutate records, arrays or options. No dependencies or frontend scaffolding. Keep package.json and acceptance.cjs byte-for-byte unchanged.

normalize(options) returns exactly {query,page,limit}. Defaults for missing fields are empty query, page 1, limit 10. Query must be a string, trimmed and lowercased. Page must be a positive safe integer; limit must be a positive safe integer at most 100. Invalid values including null, fractions and numeric strings throw RangeError.

matching(records,query) filters records by case-insensitive name substring, with empty query matching every record. Return a new array sorted by createdAt ascending then numeric id ascending for ties. Records are supplied with valid string names and integer createdAt/id. Never sort or mutate the input array or record objects.

search(records, options={}) uses the shared normalize and matching functions and returns exactly {items,total,page,pageCount,hasNext}. Apply filtering and stable ordering BEFORE pagination. Pages are 1-based. total counts all matching records; pageCount is ceil(total/limit), zero for no matches; hasNext is true iff page < pageCount. Out-of-range pages return empty items while preserving the requested page. Validation failures propagate. Empty records must still validate options.

plan: Inspect the supplied related modules, repair their shared contracts coherently, and run the protected build and test scripts. Keep package.json and acceptance.cjs immutable. Use Node built-ins only. Finish once the fixed acceptance passes; do not add features or weaken validation.

files.package.json: {"name": "pagination-repair", "private": true, "scripts": {"build": "node --check src/options.cjs && node --check src/matching.cjs && node --check src/search.cjs", "test": "node acceptance.cjs"}}
